description: Will this appliance physically fit this space? Compares dimensions plus typical installation clearances and required connections (power, water, gas).

needs.description: Connections the product needs, e.g. '120V, water line' or '240V'.

opening.description: Width, height and depth of the space it goes into. Any subset is accepted; missing axes come back as 'missing'.

depth.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

height.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

width.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

product.description: What's being installed, e.g. '36-inch French-door refrigerator'. Used to pick typical clearances.

product_dimensions.description: Width, height and depth of the product (from its spec sheet). Any subset is accepted; missing axes come back as 'missing'.

depth.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

height.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

width.description: A number in inches (e.g. "35.75") or text with units ("35 3/4 in", "90.8 cm", "908 mm").

name: check_fit
title: Check physical fit
